c1_avoid_8_6_span.name: 8-6 Day Span Avoidance
c1_avoid_8_6_span.description: Penalizes student days stretched across 10 hours (08:00 to 18:00).

c2_student_idle_gaps.name: Student Gap Minimization
c2_student_idle_gaps.description: Penalizes idle unallotted gap hours between student lectures.

c3_same_day_lec_lab.name: Same-Day Lec & Lab Separation
c3_same_day_lec_lab.description: Prevents single-subject overload by separating theory and lab onto different days.

c4_faculty_load_variance.name: Faculty Workload Balance
c4_faculty_load_variance.description: Evenly spreads teaching hours across a faculty member's active days.

c5_honours_boundary.name: Honours Boundary Placement
c5_honours_boundary.description: Places Honours and Open Electives at start (08:00) or end of day to avoid midday gaps.

c6_three_consecutive_days.name: 3-Day Consecutive Subject Spread
c6_three_consecutive_days.description: Penalizes clustering the same subject on 3 or more consecutive weekdays.

c7_faculty_gaps_over_2h.name: Faculty Long Gap Elimination
c7_faculty_gaps_over_2h.description: Prevents faculty from waiting idle on campus for more than 2 hours between classes.
